يغرنديا (form IIIq)
# يَغْرَنْدِيَا (yaḡrandiyā) /jaɣ.ran.di.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# يُغْرَنْدَيَا (yuḡrandayā) /juɣ.ran.da.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
